acknowledgements.title: Acknowledgements
acknowledgements.description: Who made the texts, translations, parallels and dictionary that Suttas Map shows, and under what licence.
intro: Suttas Map draws the Pāli Canon as a map. Everything it shows was made by others and given away: this page names them all, in the four languages the map uses — Pāli, English, French and Vietnamese.

p: The texts, their titles and summaries, the collections and the parallels between texts all come from [SuttaCentral](https://suttacentral.net) ([sc-data](https://github.com/suttacentral/sc-data), [bilara-data](https://github.com/suttacentral/bilara-data)), published under the Creative Commons CC0 dedication. Each translation remains its translator's. Every text on the map links back to SuttaCentral: please read it there, and consider [supporting them](https://suttacentral.net/donations).

The positions in the vectorial space are computed from the Pāli text itself, with the **Digital Pāḷi Dictionary** by Bhikkhu Bodhirasa ([digitalpalidictionary.github.io](https://digitalpalidictionary.github.io), [CC BY-NC 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/)) to bring every word back to its dictionary form. No dictionary entry is shown.

To every translator named above, to the Dhamma Society for the Mahāsaṅgīti edition, to the SuttaCentral team for publishing and maintaining the texts and their parallels, and to Bhikkhu Bodhirasa for the dictionary.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.description: The terms governing use of Suttas Map.
intro: These terms govern your use of Suttas Map (the “Service”), published by {{publisher}} (the “Publisher”; see [Legal](/legal)). By using the Service you accept them.

p: The Service shows the texts of the Pāli Canon as a map: the parallels published by SuttaCentral, and a space where texts are placed by the similarity of their Pāli. It is provided free of charge, without registration, and runs entirely in your browser.

Positions, links and similarity scores are computed, not judgements about the texts. Two texts close on the map may differ, and two distant ones may be related: the texts themselves, on SuttaCentral, remain the only authority.

The texts are published by SuttaCentral under CC0 and remain their translators'; the dictionary used to build the vectorial space is under CC BY-NC 4.0 (see [Acknowledgements](/acknowledgements)). The Service itself — its code, data processing, interface and name — is the property of the Publisher. You may use it for personal, non-commercial consultation.
The Service is provided as is, without guarantee of availability or accuracy. The Publisher may change or stop it at any time.
These terms are governed by French law.
